Get the Album & Feed KC How it works

Original artwork & music created in Kansas City to support Rogue Round Table’s winter community campaign.

What This Album Is

We Want A Chiefs Christmas is a full studio-style holiday album built by local creators in partnership with Rogue Round Table (RRT). It’s our way of saying “thank you” to the city that always shows up when families need help.

Why We Made It

As food costs climbed, SNAP benefits shifted, and pantries stretched past capacity, we kept hearing the same thing from partners across KC: families are falling through the cracks.

We didn’t want to just ask for one more donation — we wanted to give something joyful back. This album is that gift: a Chiefs-loving, KC-rooted Christmas soundtrack that helps kids eat with dignity.

How Your Donation Works

  1. You donate once through our GiveButter campaign.
  2. Your donation is used for fresh foods, soft foods for unhoused neighbors, school snacks, pantry restocks, and emergency aid.
  3. You receive the full We Want A Chiefs Christmas album as a free thank-you download.

Every transaction and payout runs through Rogue Round Table’s campaign reporting, so our community can see how funds were used.

What You’ll Hear

From Arrowhead-ready bangers to front-porch ballads and KC jazz throwbacks, the album covers almost every style — all anchored in the same song: “We Want A Chiefs Christmas.”

13 tracks + bonus material
Track 1 — We Want A Chiefs Christmas (Arrowhead Original) Viral stadium-pop anthem with chantable hooks and hip-hop bounce.

2:59 • Country-Folk

2:42 • EDM

Kids Club & Vault Tracks

Tracks 8–10 — Kids Club Mixes Kid-friendly party versions featuring KC Wolf energy and sing-along hooks.

You’ll receive the full digital album — including kids mixes, jazz bonus tracks, and vault cuts — with every donation through givebutter.com/gochiefs.

Terms & Conditions

These Terms & Conditions govern your use of the chiefs.idsaikc.com landing page and your participation in the We Want A Chiefs Christmas fundraiser operated by Rogue Round Table (RRT), a Kansas City–based nonprofit initiative.

Fundraiser Purpose

Donations made through the linked GiveButter campaign are used to support Rogue Round Table’s community work, including but not limited to:

  • paying down school lunch debt and cafeteria balances,
  • purchasing fresh and shelf-stable foods for families and local pantries,
  • providing emergency grocery and basic-needs assistance, and
  • supporting small, local outreach partners across the Kansas City area.

Album Access

Each completed donation made through the official campaign link (givebutter.com/gochiefs) includes access to a digital album download as a thank-you. Download links are for personal use only and may not be resold, reposted as your own work, or distributed as a standalone commercial product.

No Refunds

Because donations are charitable contributions used to fund time-sensitive community needs, all donations are considered final and non-refundable, except where otherwise required by law.

Content & Trademarks

All original music, artwork, text, and designs on this site are owned or licensed by Rogue Round Table and/or the creators who partnered on this project. Any team names, logos, or references to professional sports organizations are used in a fan-support, community context only and are not intended to imply official sponsorship or endorsement.

Changes to These Terms

Rogue Round Table may update these Terms & Conditions to reflect changes in the campaign or legal requirements. The “Last updated” date below will be revised whenever material changes are made.

Privacy Policy

Rogue Round Table respects your privacy. This Policy explains what information is collected when you visit chiefs.idsaikc.com and when you donate through our linked GiveButter campaign, and how that information is used.

Information Collected on This Site

This landing page itself does not require you to create an account or submit personal data. Standard web analytics may collect non-identifying information such as page views, device type, and general location to help us understand how supporters are finding the campaign.

Donations & Payment Data

All donations are processed securely through GiveButter. When you donate, GiveButter may collect your name, email address, payment details, and other information necessary to complete the transaction. That data is stored and managed under GiveButter’s own Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Rogue Round Table receives access to limited donor information from GiveButter (such as your name, contact information, and donation amount) for the purposes of:

  • issuing receipts,
  • thanking supporters, and
  • tracking campaign performance and impact.

How We Use Your Information

We may use the information shared with us to:

  • send donation confirmations and impact updates,
  • respond to questions or support requests, and
  • improve future campaigns and community outreach.

We do not sell or rent your personal information. We may share high-level, non-identifying summaries (for example, “number of donors by ZIP code”) when reporting campaign results to partners or the community.

Cookies & Analytics

Basic analytics tools may use cookies or similar technologies to understand how visitors navigate this site. You can manage cookie settings through your browser preferences.

Your Choices

If you wish to update, correct, or request deletion of your contact information from Rogue Round Table’s records, please contact us through the main website at rogueroundtable.com or via our listed email or social channels.

Updates to This Policy

We may revise this Privacy Policy as our technology, partners, or legal requirements change. Material updates will be reflected on this page with a new “Last updated” date.
